official_documentation.name: Claude Code Hooks
official_documentation.description: Official Claude Code hooks reference covering all 30 events, hook types (command/http/mcp_tool/prompt/agent), schemas, exit codes, matcher syntax, and execution behavior. Re-verified 2026-07-11: confirmed parallel execution of all matching hooks per event (dedup by command+args or URL, no documented tie-break for conflicting allow/deny), `allowManagedHooksOnly` enterprise lockdown, the `if` permission-rule scoping field on tool-event hooks, and that plugin `hooks/hooks.json` plus skill/agent frontmatter (with a `once` run-then-remove flag) are two more hook-bearing scopes beyond the four settings.json locations. This page itself does not state a cross-scope precedence order for hooks — see the Settings entry below for that.

official_documentation.name: Codex Hooks Reference
official_documentation.description: Official Codex hooks.json/config.toml [hooks] reference (redirects to learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks as of 2026-07). Re-verified 2026-07-11: 10 events (SessionStart, SubagentStart, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStop, Stop), only `type: command` handlers execute (prompt/agent parsed-but-skipped, async parsed-but-nonfunctional), Windows supported via `commandWindows` override (corrects an earlier no-Windows assumption), default timeout 600s, toggle via `[features] hooks = false`.

official_documentation.name: Claude Models Overview (pricing + lineup)
official_documentation.description: Official current + legacy Claude model table with API IDs and per-MTok pricing. Verified 2026-07-11: current flagship Claude Opus 4.8 ($5/$25 per MTok), Claude Sonnet 5 ($2/$10 introductory through 2026-08-31, $3/$15 standard after), Claude Haiku 4.5 ($1/$5); Claude Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6 are now legacy-but-served. Use to keep any cost-estimation reference (e.g. budget-and-loop-hooks.md) from drifting.

community_resources.name: Claude Code Settings & Environment Variables
community_resources.description: Official Claude Code settings reference covering configuration scopes and settings.json structure. Re-verified 2026-07-11: exact precedence is managed > CLI flags > project `.claude/settings.local.json` > project `.claude/settings.json` > user `~/.claude/settings.json` — corrects a prior version of this skill that ranked `.claude/settings.local.json` last instead of third. Note permission rules (and hook registrations) merge across scopes rather than strictly override, so this order mainly resolves single-value setting conflicts.
